send_message.title: Send a notification message to the channel
send_message.description: Post a text message through the Brosix Notifications API to the Channel this API key belongs to. Each Channel links one notification Service to either a single team member or a Chat Room, so the recipient is fixed by the key rather than chosen per call; a Chat Room channel delivers the message to every participant. Brosix answers HTTP 200 with a JSON `result` code whether or not delivery succeeded, so inspect `result` rather than the status. This is the only operation the Notifications API exposes; to reach a different user or room, use a connection made with that channel's API key.
send_message.notes: The message is delivered immediately and cannot be recalled through the API. The trailing slash on the path matters: /message/send without it answers with a redirect.

msg.description: The message text that will be sent to the channel's user or chat room, shown in the Brosix app as a message from the notification service.

output.description: Brosix's JSON status envelope. `result` is a numeric status code; an invalid or revoked API key comes back as a non-success code (observed: 12) with HTTP 200.

result.description: Numeric status code for the send attempt.
